en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a picturesque valley with two lakes surrounded by forested hills and mountains. There are small villages and scattered houses along the slopes and near the lakeshores. The landscape is alpine, with terraced fields and coniferous trees, and dramatically rising mountains in the background. There is no visible modern infrastructure, giving the scene a timeless, historical appearance.
